verdict.rationale: Runloop offers an official MCP server and Cursor `.mdc` rule files that give AI assistants context on the Runloop SDK, letting an AI-native user drive devbox creation/management via connected agents rather than only the CLI/dashboard. However, there is no evidence of a native built-in natural-language command interface for Runloop itself (the CLI is a traditional CLI/TUI, not NL-driven). Missing for 10: evidence of a first-party conversational/NL interface built into Runloop's own CLI or dashboard, and independent confirmation that MCP-based control reliably covers all platform actions.
